issues.description: The solution's Animal class (and its subclasses) define a constructor that requires (String name, int age) and include an 'age' attribute, whereas the problem statement and the provided template/Main expect animals to be constructed with only a name (and the UML/description only lists 'name' as the Animal attribute). This constructor/attribute mismatch will cause confusion and compilation problems: the example Main in the template calls new Seal("Clarabelle") / new Pig("Doodle") / new Goat("Buttinsky"), which do not match the solution constructors requiring an additional int age parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep the API consistent across artifacts. Either remove the 'age' attribute and the two-argument constructors from the solution (change Animal and subclasses to have a single-argument constructor Animal(String name) and subclasses Seal/Pig/Goat(String name)), or update the problem statement and the template Main to require and demonstrate the age parameter (e.g., change examples to new Seal("Clarabelle", 3) and update the UML/description to include the age attribute). Choose one approach and apply it to problem_statement.md, the template Main, and all solution/template class constructors so they match.
